name: Devin Oncall
desc: Agent that picks up incidents and pages when something breaks.
desc_zh: 出事时接手告警和电话值守的智能体。
solves: On-call rotation means being woken for triage before anyone knows the cause; the agent gathers logs and recent changes and proposes the fix.
solves_zh: 值班意味着还没弄清原因就被叫起来做排查；智能体会先汇总日志和近期改动，再给出修复建议。
best_for: You are on call and want the first ten minutes of an incident done before you open the laptop.
best_for_zh: 轮到你值班，想在打开电脑前先有人做完事故前十分钟的排查。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — devin.ai/blog directory）。 Announced as a launch in the opening line of the post. 首次公开日期来源：https://devin.ai/blog/introducing-devin-oncall
